question: In Young's double-slit experiment, explain why bright fringes and dark fringes appear alternately on the screen.

options.A: Bright and dark fringes alternate because slit separation changes from point to point.
options.B: Bright and dark fringes alternate because the wavelength changes continuously across the screen.
options.C: Moving away from the centre changes the path difference gradually. Bright fringes occur at $\Delta x=n\lambda$ (constructive interference), while dark fringes occur at $\Delta x=\left(n+\dfrac12\right)\lambda$ (destructive interference). These conditions occur alternately, so bright and dark fringes appear alternately.
options.D: Bright and dark fringes alternate because the two slit sources are incoherent.
